cases.description: A dependency on LangGraph alone does not establish an active agent
A declared LangGraph dependency is framework usage, even without an agent

A configured remote MCP server is discoverable
Codex TOML inline server table under mcp_servers is active
Codex TOML dotted key mcp_servers.active is an active server
An MCP registry manifest with an actual package is discoverable
An empty MCP JSON mapping configures no server
An empty MCP JSONC mapping configures no server
An empty Codex TOML MCP table configures no server
An empty MCP YAML mapping configures no server
A disabled only MCP JSON mapping configures no active server
A disabled only Codex MCP server configures no active server

cases.description: Only the enabled Codex MCP TOML server is counted
Generic web service metadata is not an MCP registry manifest
Go source comments and quoted examples do not create an agent
A Go agent construction remains visible after commented and quoted examples
An HTML-only PHP template has no executable agent call
A short PHP echo tag calls an unbound helper; its name alone does not establish a LangChain agent
A Claude Code instructions file is a coding agent configuration

cases.description: Ordinary documentation is not a coding agent configuration
An ordinary queue consumer is not an autonomous AI agent
A bare tool decorator is neither LangChain attribution nor agent execution
An OpenAI Responses model call and active named tool dispatch identify an agent
A model call with named tools, a function-call response and assigned handler result identifies an agent

files.worker.py:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI()
response = client.responses.create(model='gpt-4o', tools=TOOLS, input='query')
calls = [item for item in response.output if item.type == 'function_call']
for item in calls:
    answer = lookup(item.arguments)
    conversation.append({'type': 'function_call_output', 'call_id': item.call_id, 'output': answer})

cases.description: A model response branch without named tool dispatch is not sufficient
Independent model calls and tool lookup helpers in separate files are not joined into an agent
